“陛下，您快告诉我，咱们刚才看到的都不是真的！”
这一刻。
随着沈浪从丽春院离开。
也跟着走出来的上官冉，心态崩了。
她无法接受，沈浪靠着卖她，赚了一百万灵石。
而她还亏了九百枚！
同样也觉得有些梦幻的，还有神霄。
一百万灵石呀！
几乎是大乾王朝一年的税收了。
结果，沈浪就这么轻轻松松的赚来了。
哪怕使用的手段，有些下三滥。
可他却是实打实的赚到了一百万！
甚至还间接的帮助她，搞清楚了丽春院的主子是谁？
这使得神霄，也忍不住在上官冉的胳膊上掐了一下。
疼的上官冉哇哇大叫后，才心潮澎湃道：“是真的，你都疼了！”
“陛下！！！”
上官冉脸都绿了。
尼玛。
试验真假，你掐我是吧？

还算是个人？
神霄也是腼腆一笑：“别喊了，这一千枚灵石，算是你的辛苦费，行了不？”
“陛下，我觉得我还能再去卖一次！”上官冉眼泛精光。
神霄嘴角一抽：“滚犊子，你没听安亦瑶那个贱婢说，丽春院是镇北王的买卖吗？”
“你觉得同样的方法，镇北王还能花钱了事？”
听到神霄提起她的镇北王，上官冉瞬间沉默了。
因为在大乾王朝，镇北王可是一位二品巅峰的武夫。
不夸张的说，当初要不是神霄在登基时，恢复记忆回来了。
现在的大乾王朝当家人，就是镇北王。
这样的存在，坑了他一次，再想去坑第二次，着实有些自取其辱了！
于是，觉得事情好像变的复杂了的上官冉，也是缓缓眯起眼：
“陛下，您说沈浪故意把我卖到丽春院，然后再找丽春院要钱，是不是想激发您跟镇北王的矛盾，从而瓦解咱们大乾王朝？”
面对上官冉的询问，神霄也是蹙紧眉头：“朕也不知沈浪到底是故意的，还是无意之举！”
“要不，咱们试探一下他？”上官冉提议。
“怎么试探？”神霄追问。
“我伪装成大亓王朝的人，主动跟他接触，询问他有什么情报传递回去？”
“若是他有情报传递，便可以证明，他就是大亓王朝的人！”
“您觉得如何？”
content_en:
;;
"Your Majesty, tell me quickly, what we just saw is not true!"
This moment.
As Shen Lang left Li Chun Yuan.
Shangguan Ran, who also walked out, was mentally shattered.
She couldn't accept that Shen Lang made a million spiritual stones by selling her.
And she lost nine hundred coins!
Also feeling a bit dreamy is Shenxiao.
One million spiritual stones!
It’s almost as much as the Daqian Dynasty’s tax revenue for one year.
As a result, Shen Lang earned it so easily.
Even if the methods used are a bit dirty.
But he actually made a million!
He even indirectly helped her figure out who the master of Li Chun Courtyard was?
This made Shen Xiao couldn't help but pinch Shangguan Ran's arm.
After Shangguan Ran screamed in pain, he said with excitement: "It's true, you are in pain!"
"Your Majesty!!!"
Shangguan Ran's face turned green.
Damn it.
Testing authenticity, you pinch me, right?
Still a human being?
Shen Xiao also smiled shyly: "Stop shouting, these thousand spirit stones can be regarded as your hard work, okay?"
"Your Majesty, I think I can sell it again!" Shangguan Ran's eyes flashed.
The corner of Shen Xiao's mouth twitched: "You idiot, didn't you listen to that bitch An Yiyao say that Li Chun Courtyard is a business of King Zhenbei?"
"Do you think King Zhenbei can spend money to solve the problem using the same method?"
Shangguan Ran fell silent for a moment when she heard Shen Xiao mentioning her Zhenbei King.
Because in the Daqian Dynasty, King Zhenbei was a peak second-grade martial artist.
It is no exaggeration to say that if Shen Xiao had not restored his memory when he ascended the throne, he would have returned.
The current head of the Daqian Dynasty is King Zhenbei.
Such a being had tricked him once and wanted to trick him a second time. It was really a bit of a humiliation for himself!
Therefore, Shangguan Ran, who felt that things seemed to have become complicated, slowly narrowed his eyes:
"Your Majesty, you said that Shen Lang deliberately sold me to Li Chun Yuan, and then asked Li Chun Yuan for money. Did he want to provoke a conflict between you and King Zhenbei, thereby disintegrating our Daqian Dynasty?"
Facing Shangguan Ran's inquiry, Shen Xiao also frowned: "I don't know whether Shen Lang did it intentionally or unintentionally!"
"How about we test him?" Shangguan Ran suggested.
"How to test?" Shen Xiao asked.
"I pretended to be a member of the Daqi Dynasty, took the initiative to contact him, and asked him what information he had to pass back?"
"If he has information to pass on, it can prove that he is from the Qi Dynasty!"
"What do you think?"
